title.zh: Codex CLI：一个项目一个工作区
title.en: Codex CLI: one workspace per project

summary.zh: 把每个项目目录当成一个独立工作区：目录内可写、目录外只读、审批不回弹，再按仓库拆分 GitHub 身份。记录这套配置怎么搭、实测结果和五个坑。
summary.en: Every project folder becomes its own workspace: writable inside, read-only outside, no approval prompt ever comes back, and the GitHub identity split per repository. How the setup is built, what it measured, and the five things that bit back.
